name: relaydeck
description: Relaydeck: the simple management UI embedded in the relay binary.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:dist
scripts.check:dist: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- ../../internal/relaydeck/dist)" || (git status --short -- ../../internal/relaydeck/dist && echo "internal/relaydeck/dist is out of date: run npm run build and commit it" && exit 1)
